title: Special Weather Statement by NWS - NewsBreak
text:
9 minutes ago Check NWS updates here
Effective: 2026-06-10 23:26:00 CDT Expires: 2026-06-11 00:30:00 CDT Urgency: Expected Severity: Moderate Certainty: Observed Instruction: Monitor the weather situation closely and be alert for threatening weather conditions. Target Area: Langlade; Menominee; Marathon; Shawano At 1126 PM CDT, Doppler radar was tracking a line of strong thunderstorms extending from 10 miles southwest of Antigo to near Bevent, or extending from 10 miles southwest of Antigo to 19 miles southeast of Wausau, moving east at 40 mph.
HAZARD...Wind gusts up to 30 mph and pea size hail.
SOURCE...Radar indicated.
IMPACT...Gusty winds could knock down tree limbs and blow around unsecured objects. Minor damage to outdoor objects is possible.
The strong thunderstorm will be near... Bevent around 1130 PM CDT. Wittenberg and Antigo around 1140 PM CDT. Neopit around 1155 PM CDT. Keshena and Legend Lake around 1215 AM CDT. Big Smokey Falls around 1220 AM CDT. South Branch around 1225 AM CDT.
Other locations impacted by this strong thunderstorm include Norrie, Hogarty, Elderon, Pike Lake, Hatley, Glandon, Aniwa, Birnamwood, Eland and Elmhurst.
